title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteer Night at Convoy of Hope
description: This is a Giving Tuesday volunteer event at Convoy of Hope's headquarters, where volunteers count, sort, and box or bag product during the Hands of Hope session, then help clean up their work area. Youth ages 10-17 may take part with a signed parental consent form, youth under 10 are not eligible, and everyone needs closed-toe shoes and a current liability waiver; registration through the chamber's link is required before volunteering. It runs Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
